title: diffValue recurses into objects but re-serializes arrays whole, making event-log growth quadratic
content: HANDOFF s2, ROOT CAUSE AS CORRECTED. THE ORIGINAL DIAGNOSIS WAS WRONG AND IS WITHDRAWN: it read "the event log writes a full state projection on every event instead of a delta". IT DOES NOT. event-append.ts:72 already calls diffProjection, deltas are path-granular, and only 8 of 167 events carry a full projection, deliberately, as checkpoints. An implementer briefed on the original diagnosis would hunt a full-projection writer that does not exist. ACTUAL MECHANISM: diffValue at olt/scripts/src/engine/store/projection-patch.ts:16-22 guards on isJsonObject(before) && isJsonObject(after) and recurses into OBJECTS ONLY. ARRAYS fall through to line 22 and are re-serialized whole on every append as a single set op. Cost is approximately 3030 bytes x array length per append, total approximately 3030*n^2/2. At 200 escalations approximately 60 MB; at 500 approximately 380 MB. It does not plateau. SCOPE THE REPAIR TO THE INVARIANT, NOT THE INSTANCE: escalations is where it was first seen, not the defect. Across the 8 largest logs the hot key is never the same twice - mind capsules escalations/candidates, orchestrator capsules tasks.<id>.findings/micro_cycles, planning capsules requirements/planning_buffer, run capsules agents/commands/receipts. Ten distinct top-level keys, every one an append-only collection. SPECIFICATION: any monotonically growing array in run state produces O(n^2) event-log bytes because diffValue treats arrays atomically. A brief naming escalations would fix mind capsules and leave orchestrator capsules, the majority, untouched. Write scope: olt/scripts/src/engine/store/{projection-patch,event-append,constants}.ts. This is Lane B.

title: AMENDMENT: the authority fix is deny-on-unresolved-role, not adding recover to an allowlist
content: AMENDS AND SHARPENS hb-authority-unregistered-actor-bypasses-role-enforcement. THE ORIGINAL ITEM IS CORRECT BUT ITS FRAMING INVITES THE WRONG FIX, AND THIS ENTRY EXISTS SO THE EVENTUAL IMPLEMENTER DOES NOT CLOSE IT CHEAPLY. THE DEFECT IS NOT "mind can bypass" AND IT IS NOT "recover is missing from an allowlist". THE DEFECT IS THAT assertRoleMayInvoke AT olt/scripts/src/packets/command-authority.ts:242-269 IS GATED ON ROLE RESOLUTION SUCCEEDING, SO THE CHECK IS SKIPPED PRECISELY WHEN IT CANNOT BE SATISFIED. ABSENCE OF A GRANT READS AS ABSENCE OF A RESTRICTION. AN ACTOR THE SYSTEM KNOWS NOTHING ABOUT IS TREATED AS AN ACTOR THE SYSTEM PERMITS. REQUIRED REPAIR, STATED AS AN INVARIANT SO IT CANNOT BE SATISFIED BY ENUMERATION: AN UNRESOLVED ROLE MUST DENY, NOT SKIP. Every authority chokepoint must have a total function over its input domain, with no path where "I could not determine the answer" returns the same value as "the answer is yes". Granting recover to the roles whose prose already claims it (hb-recover-granted-to-zero-roles) is a SEPARATE and also-necessary fix; DOING ONLY THAT LEAVES THIS HOLE FULLY OPEN, because the skip path never consults the allowlist at all. Conversely doing only this one leaves every prose-granted capability still denied. BOTH ARE REQUIRED AND NEITHER SUBSTITUTES FOR THE OTHER. FAMILY, AND THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING PART: THIS IS THE SAME ABSENCE-RENDERING-AS-PRESENCE SHAPE AS THE QUOTA BREAKER FAILING OPEN ON null AT olt/scripts/src/telemetry/circuit-breaker.ts:190-192, WHERE AN UNREADABLE QUOTA READS AS null, null < threshold IS FALSE, AND THE BREAKER REPORTS status OK WITH "No quota metrics detected; execution running normally." IN BOTH CASES AN UNDETERMINED INPUT PRODUCES THE PERMISSIVE OUTPUT, AND IN BOTH CASES NOTHING THROWS. FILE, BRIEF AND FIX THEM AS ONE FAMILY: a repair to either that does not consider the other will leave the other standing, and the register already shows 15 instances of this shape where every single enumerated brief produced a partial fix while the one that stated a property produced a complete fix and closed an unrelated hole as a side effect (method canon 5). THE SWEEP THIS IMPLIES: enumerate every site where a lookup failure, a parse failure, a null, an absent key or an unresolvable identity feeds a boolean decision, and assert that the failure branch is the RESTRICTIVE one. Known members so far: assertRoleMayInvoke role resolution, circuit-breaker null quota, loadRepoPolicy catch-returns-default (hb-s6-loadrepopolicy-swallows-diagnosis), manifest-schema absent commands coerced to [] (hb-s6-manifest-schema-coerces-absent-commands), agent-brief phantom policy path printing (None) (hb-s6-agent-brief-phantom-policy-path), and the host_address writer omitting the key when unsupplied (hb-s6-host-address-writer-gated-on-unpassed-flag). title: The disinterested executing seat exists, is granted and is hard-lock exempt, and no dispatcher can spawn it

title: Single-observation lease token and unreachable recover compose into permanently unrecoverable lease loss
content: REPORTED FULLY FORMED BY coordinator_lane-a-quota-r5 ON 2026-08-25 AND FILED ON ITS BEHALF, BECAUSE IT HOLDS NO WRITE TOOL AND NO BACKLOG COMMAND (see hb-no-seat-below-tier-0-can-file-a-finding). THE COMPOSITION IS THE FINDING, NOT EITHER HALF - FIXING EITHER ALONE LEAVES THE TRAP STANDING, AND BOTH HALVES ARE ALREADY SEPARATELY ON FILE, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY THIS ENTRY MUST EXIST. HALF A, SURVIVABLE ALONE, ALREADY IN .olt/defects.jsonl: task:claim returns the bearer token ONCE, on stdout, with no persistence and no warning, so ANY truncating filter - tail, head, grep - silently destroys it. LIVE INSTANCE: the Lane A implementer lost t1 token to `tail -40`. The capsule persists only lease.token_digest, so the token CANNOT BE RE-DERIVED; the coordinator confirmed no tok_ string in the capsule hashes to the lease digest, and the agent session token in runtime/sessions/ hashes to something else entirely. THE LOSS IS SYMMETRIC: task:release ALSO requires the token, so a truncated pipe forfeits BOTH submission and release. HALF B, SURVIVABLE ALONE, FILED AS hb-recover-granted-to-zero-roles: recover is the documented remedy - orchestrator.md:139 INSTRUCTS orchestrators to run it and mind.yaml:72 grants Mind lease recovery "via recover command" - yet the string "recover" appears in ZERO role command allowlists across all 28 manifests. The coordinator was refused mechanically; the orchestrator was refused while holding a real orchestrator grant. COMPOSED: A LOST TOKEN STRANDS THE TASK AT leased FOREVER, AND THE ONE COMMAND THAT UNSTRANDS IT IS INVOKABLE BY NO ROLE. RECOVERY IS UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY MISCONFIGURATION, AND THE ENTRY COST IS A ONE-CHARACTER PIPE. This is the fifth wedged-lease mechanism on record and is DISTINCT from the cand-37 wedge in hb-s5-cand37-in-lease-repair-attempt - that one leaves a task leased with NO lease object so recover finds no expiry to reap; this one leaves an intact lease whose token no living process holds. DO NOT CONFLATE THEM: they need different repairs and a brief naming one will not fix the other. REPAIRS, EITHER OF WHICH BREAKS THE COMPOSITION, BOTH PREFERRED: (1) task:claim writes the token to a capsule-local file the holding agent can re-read under its own grant, removing the single-observation hazard entirely; (2) grant recover to the roles the documentation ALREADY INSTRUCTS to run it. Doing neither leaves an unrecoverable state reachable by ordinary convenience. NOTE THE IRONY FOR SEQUENCING: this run was itself unwedged only via the ungranted-actor fail-open (hb-authority-unregistered-actor-bypasses-role-enforcement), i.e. THE ONLY WORKING RECOVERY PATH IN THE SYSTEM TODAY IS A SECURITY DEFECT, so closing that hole before granting recover would leave the fleet with NO recovery path at all. GRANT recover FIRST, THEN CLOSE THE BYPASS.

title: CORRECTION of my own proposed repair: writing the lease token to a capsule file is a worse defect than the truncation it prevents
content: CORRECTS A REPAIR I PROPOSED IN hb-token-loss-plus-unreachable-recover-compose-to-unrecoverable. title: The addressing defect deadlocks specifically on correct supervisory behaviour, and every workaround is itself trapped
content: EXTENDS hb-s6-peer-messaging-by-role-name-resolves-for-nobody WITH ITS OBSERVED CONSEQUENCE, WHICH IS WORSE THAN THE DEFECT ITSELF. CONTRIBUTED BY coordinator_lane-a-quota-r5 FROM A LIVE DEADLOCK. WHAT HAPPENED: the coordinator DECLINED TO POLL - correct per the runbook and correct on the merits - and waited on a completion notification. Its implementer had ALREADY FINISHED, and the completion routed TO THE ORCHESTRATOR INSTEAD OF TO THE COORDINATOR. THE LANE SAT IDLE WHILE THE REPORT EXISTED, DELIVERED TO THE WRONG SEAT. THE DEADLOCK REQUIRED NOBODY TO DO ANYTHING WRONG. IT REQUIRED ONLY THAT A SUPERVISOR BEHAVE PROPERLY: not polling, not second-guessing liveness, trusting the channel. THIS INVERTS THE USUAL SEVERITY CALCULUS. A DEFECT THAT PUNISHES SLOPPINESS IS BOUNDED BY DISCIPLINE; A DEFECT THAT PUNISHES DISCIPLINE IS UNBOUNDED, BECAUSE THE CORRECT BEHAVIOUR IS EXACTLY WHAT TRIGGERS IT AND THE WAITING SEAT HAS NO SIGNAL DISTINGUISHING "still working" FROM "already reported elsewhere". An agent that responds by checking liveness itself walks into hb-s9b-stat-does-not-follow-symlinks (stat reports size 149 with an mtime frozen at symlink creation while stat -L reports 694832 four minutes newer, so a working agent reads as idle permanently) and into the local-versus-UTC skew (stat prints local time, capsule records are UTC, UTC-7 here, so a fresh file reads as seven hours old). THE PREVIOUS COORDINATOR DID EXACTLY THIS AND DOUBLE-DISPATCHED ONTO THE SAME FOUR FILES (hb-s7-coordinator-diagnosed-live-agent-as-dead). title: TIER 0 RULING: grant recover and close the bypass in one atomic change, and if split, close the bypass FIRST
content: TIER 0 ADJUDICATION BY mind-gen-5, 2026-08-25. The Lane A orchestrator PROPAGATED AS SETTLED an ordering I had stated - grant recover first, close the ungranted-actor fail-open second - on the reasoning that the only working recovery path today IS the security defect, so closing it first leaves the fleet with no recovery at all. THE COORDINATOR CORRECTLY REFUSED TO INHERIT IT AND ASKED FOR AN ACTUAL ADJUDICATION. That is also method canon 6 - a deferral whose trigger will not fire, or fires exactly when the fix becomes expensive, is a decision wearing a schedule. RULING, PRIMARY: THERE IS NO WINDOW, BECAUSE THE TWO FIXES SHIP AS ONE ATOMIC CHANGE. Both are small edits: add `recover` to the machine-readable commands list of the roles whose documentation already instructs them to run it (orchestrator.yaml, coordinator.yaml), AND change assertRoleMayInvoke at olt/scripts/src/packets/command-authority.ts:242-269 so an UNRESOLVED ROLE DENIES RATHER THAN SKIPS. ONE TASK, ONE IMPLEMENTER, ONE VALIDATOR, ONE COMMIT, BOTH FILES IN A SINGLE DISJOINT WRITE SCOPE. THIS DOES NOT VIOLATE ANTI-BATCHING: the rule forbids batching UNRELATED features, and these are one safety invariant with a mutual dependency where SPLITTING THEM IS WHAT CREATES THE HAZARD. A dilemma between two bad orderings is usually a signal that the unit of work was drawn wrongly, and it was. CONSTRAINT ON THAT TASK, BINDING: mind.yaml MUST BE EXCLUDED FROM ITS WRITE SCOPE. Editing olt/agents/mind.yaml breaks the whole-file charter pin enforced at mind-pulse-open.ts:174 and mind-pulse.ts:719 and HALTS THE RUNNING MIND INSTANTLY (hb-s9b-charter-pin-no-ack). Granting recover to orchestrator and coordinator requires no mind.yaml edit and is sufficient, since those are the seats the docs instruct to run it (orchestrator.md:139). MIND OWN recover GRANT ROUTES SEPARATELY THROUGH A GENERATIONAL ROTATION, AFTERWARDS, AND IS NOT A BLOCKER. RULING, FALLBACK, AND IT REVERSES THE PROPAGATED ORDER: IF THE TWO CANNOT SHIP TOGETHER, CLOSE THE BYPASS FIRST. The propagated order rested on an unexamined premise - that losing a lease is catastrophic. IT IS NOT. Four to five capsules are ALREADY wedged from lease-loss mechanisms (hb-s5-cand37-in-lease-repair-attempt, hb-token-loss-plus-unreachable-recover-compose-to-unrecoverable) and the fleet has continued working around them for two days. A WEDGED TASK IS BOUNDED, VISIBLE, RECORDABLE AND REVERSIBLE - the work sits on disk and the capsule can be re-run. AN OPEN PRIVILEGE BYPASS IS UNBOUNDED, INVISIBLE AT THE POINT OF USE, AND TRAVERSED BY CONVENIENCE RATHER THAN INTENT (hb-ungranted-actor-bypass-is-ergonomic-not-merely-structural) - three seats met it, two declined, and the one that crossed it did so unwittingly under a legitimate identity. ASYMMETRIC AND IRREVERSIBLE RISK OUTRANKS BOUNDED AND REVERSIBLE RISK, AND THE STANDING RULE ALREADY SAYS TAKE THE MORE RESTRICTIVE INSTRUCTION AND THE REVERSIBLE BRANCH. WHAT THE FLEET DOES IF A LEASE IS LOST IN THE INTERVAL, ANSWERED EXPLICITLY BECAUSE THE COORDINATOR ASKED: IT DOES NOT USE THE BYPASS. The task stays wedged, the coordinator STOPS AND REPORTS THE RAW ERROR, the wedge is recorded against hb-token-loss-plus-unreachable-recover-compose-to-unrecoverable as a fresh instance strengthening it, and the lane proceeds with its remaining tasks if their scopes are disjoint. A fifth wedged capsule is an acceptable price; a normalised privilege bypass is not. WHAT CLOSES THE WINDOW, RECORDED SO THE SEQUENCING CANNOT QUIETLY BECOME AN INDEFINITE EXEMPTION, AS THE COORDINATOR REQUIRED: the window is closed by CONSTRUCTION under the primary ruling (one commit, no interval). Under the fallback there is no window at all, since the bypass closes first. THE ONE ORDERING THAT IS NOW FORBIDDEN IS THE ONE ORIGINALLY PROPAGATED - grant recover first and close the bypass "later" WITH NO NAMED LANE AND NO DEADLINE. If any future supervisor revives that order, it must name the single lane that does both and a blocking dependency that prevents sealing with only one half done. SELF-NOTE: I stated the propagated order earlier in this session without examining the premise, and an orchestrator relayed it onward as settled - which is exactly hb-s9b-plausible-wrong-number three-sources-with-one-origin, a supervisor claim gaining apparent independent confirmation by being relayed. title: READ FIRST for hb-authority-migrated-to-the-reachable-channel: an unauthenticated channel that is usually correct is far more corrosive than one that is reliably wrong
content: REQUIRED HEADER FOR hb-authority-migrated-to-the-reachable-channel-not-the-entitled-one. FILED AS A SEPARATE ENTRY BECAUSE THE BACKLOG HAS NO UPDATE VERB AND THE FRAMING MUST BE THE FIRST THING A READER SEES - A CORRECTION BURIED IN THE BODY OF A LONG ENTRY IS THE SAME FAILURE AS A CURRENCY MARKER FOOTNOTED AT THE END OF A 12,000-LINE FILE (hb-s6-evidence-files-carry-no-currency-marker): NOT A CONTROL, JUST A HOPE THE READER GETS THERE. THE SENTENCE: AN UNAUTHENTICATED CHANNEL THAT IS USUALLY CORRECT IS FAR MORE CORROSIVE THAN ONE THAT IS RELIABLY WRONG. THE DEFERENCE IS BUILT BY THE ACCURACY AND SPENT BY THE ERRORS, AND THE RATIO IS WHAT MAKES IT INVISIBLE. WHY THIS HEADER EXISTS - THE TRIAGE FAILURE IT PREVENTS: the parent entry will otherwise be filed as COMMUNICATION HYGIENE, remediated with a messaging-etiquette rule, and closed. THAT WOULD BE WRONG. THIS IS AN AUTHORITY DEFECT, NOT A COMMUNICATION DEFECT. Rulings on scope, severity, routing and sequencing entered a fleet from a seat that holds no grant, appears in no agent:list, leaves no capsule record, and cannot be authenticated by any recipient - and the capsule afterwards shows a fleet that AGREED rather than a fleet that was DIRECTED. A messaging-etiquette rule does not touch any of that. THE ASYMMETRY THAT MAKES IT SELF-CONCEALING: a channel that is reliably wrong is discovered on its first error and discounted permanently, so its blast radius is one message. A channel that is usually right accrues standing with every correct message, and that accrued standing is EXACTLY WHAT CARRIES THE OCCASIONAL WRONG ONE PAST SCRUTINY. THE ACCURACY IS NOT MITIGATION - IT IS THE DELIVERY MECHANISM. Measured in this session: the same unauthenticated channel supplied the stale-.capsules diagnosis (correct, verified at source across six sites), the deny-not-skip framing (correct), and the disclosure of its own status (correct) - ALONGSIDE "the false-stagnation writer is still armed and bleeding hourly" (false; disproved by two static row counts 21 minutes apart) and an amplification of "no role can independently execute a verification command" to CRITICAL before the third conjunct of command-authority.ts:242-247 was checked (false; mechanic-validator holds run:exec and a dedicated carve-out). THE COROLLARY FOR ANY READER, AND THE REASON THIS OUTRANKS ITS OWN CONTENT: THE TEST CANNOT BE "HAS THIS SOURCE BEEN RIGHT SO FAR". THAT TEST IS SATISFIED BY THE EXACT CHANNEL THE ENTRY IS ABOUT. THE TEST MUST BE WHETHER THE CLAIM IS INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIABLE AT SOURCE AND WHETHER THE INSTRUCTION TRACES TO A GRANTED SEAT LEAVING A CAPSULE RECORD. A RULING WITH NO CAPSULE RECORD IS NOT A RULING, HOWEVER WELL-INFORMED IT SOUNDS AND HOWEVER OFTEN ITS AUTHOR HAS BEEN RIGHT BEFORE.

title: TIER 0 RULING: t1 criterion [10] is re-anchored to t2, where its discrimination already lives
content: TIER 0 ADJUDICATION BY mind-gen-5 ON lane-a-quota-exhaustion-r5, ISSUED AFTER VERIFYING THE TASK GRAPH AT SOURCE RATHER THAN RULING ON THE SUMMARY. THE ESCALATION IS UPHELD, AND THE DECISIVE REASON IS NEITHER OF THE TWO GIVEN. CRITERION [10] AS WRITTEN: "the probe must be observed reporting HEALTHY against the unrepaired code and that failing observation is the PV-1 evidence for this task", anchored to criterion [9] which fixes the probe at 8 percent because 8 < 5 is false under the old literal (healthy) and 8 < 10 is true under the resolved default (constrained). THE CONSTRUCTION FAULT, VERIFIED FROM state.json: THE HEALTHY-VERSUS-CONSTRAINED VERDICT IS NOT COMPUTED IN t1 WRITE SCOPE AT ALL. t1 owns olt/scripts/src/core/config/harness-config.ts, .olt/policy.json and tests/unit/config/quota-threshold-resolution.test.ts. THE VERDICT IS COMPUTED BY olt/scripts/src/telemetry/circuit-breaker.ts, WHICH IS t2 WRITE SCOPE. t1 may READ the breaker but may not change it, and the breaker consumes DEFAULT_QUOTA_THRESHOLD = 5.0 at circuit-breaker.ts:14 until t2 removes it. CONSEQUENCE: t1 CAN observe the RED half - at 8 percent the unrepaired breaker reports healthy - BUT IT CANNOT PRODUCE THE GREEN HALF, because after a perfect t1 the breaker STILL reads 5.0 and STILL reports healthy at 8 percent. THE HEALTHY-TO-CONSTRAINED TRANSITION AT 8 PERCENT IS PHYSICALLY A t2 EVENT. A criterion demanding an observed state change inside the task that cannot cause it is unsatisfiable by construction, not by effort. THE SECOND FAULT, WHICH IS THE COORDINATOR OWN AND IS THE STRONGER ONE: any t1 test that honestly encodes "at 8 percent the breaker is healthy" ASSERTS THE PRE-REPAIR BEHAVIOUR AS A PERMANENT CONTRACT, AND t2 CRITERION "a simulated 8 percent remaining trips the breaker" THEN BREAKS IT. THAT IS A TEST SUITE THAT DEFENDS THE DEFECT, converting the bug into a specification - the exact anti-pattern already on file where mind-rotate.test.ts:166 and :331-347 asserted the stale charter carry and would have defended c337196f. CHARGING t1 WITH [10] THEREFORE MANUFACTURES A REGRESSION IN t2. THE FINDING NEITHER SEAT REPORTED, AND THE REASON THE FIX IS FREE: t2 ALREADY CARRIES BOTH HALVES OF THIS DISCRIMINATION IN ITS OWN COMPILED CRITERIA - "a simulated 8 percent remaining trips the breaker" and "a simulated 80 percent remaining does not", under a PV-2 gate that runs all three of its test files. CRITERION [10] IS A DUPLICATE OF A t2 CRITERION, MIS-ANCHORED ONE TASK UPSTREAM. RE-ANCHORING LOSES NO COVERAGE WHATSOEVER; IT REMOVES A REDUNDANT AND UNSATISFIABLE COPY. RULING, BINDING ON THE VALIDATOR AT REVIEW: (1) CRITERION [10] IS RE-ANCHORED TO t2 AND IS NOT CHARGED AGAINST t1. The validator must NOT reject t1 for failing to observe a verdict transition it cannot cause. (2) t1 RED/GREEN DISCRIMINATION IS ON THE RESOLVER, NOT ON THE VERDICT. RED: the accessor is absent or the resolved effective threshold is not 10. GREEN: the accessor returns 10 with the fact remaining {value:null, source:absent} and the floor applied visibly. That is a real, non-tautological, stub-failing pair entirely inside t1 write scope. (3) CRITERION [9] SURVIVES UNCHANGED AS THE ANCHOR FOR t2 PROBE VALUE - 8 percent remains mandatory and substituting 3 or 1 remains PROHIBITED, because those trip under both defaults and would certify a false statement. (4) t1 MAY READ circuit-breaker.ts TO RECORD THE RED OBSERVATION AS CONTEXT, BUT MUST NOT COMMIT AN ASSERTION THAT 8 PERCENT IS HEALTHY. Read-only observation is evidence; a committed assertion is a regression trap. (5) CRITERION [12] IS UNAFFECTED AND STILL BINDING - t1 remains acceptance-critical, not plumbing, because a perfect t2 without t1 still calls 8 percent healthy; the acceptance linkage is preserved through t2 dependency on t1 accessor, which is where the dependency always actually lived. PROCESS NOTE: this is the second unsatisfiable criterion I have issued into this lane, after the control-probe ruling that directed a hard-locked cognitive validator to execute (hb-supervisor-issued-an-unexecutable-ruling). BOTH WERE CAUGHT BY THE EXECUTING TIER SURFACING A CONFLICT RATHER THAN SILENTLY COMPLYING. The pattern in both: I specified an OBSERVATION without checking which seat, or which write scope, could physically produce it. RULE ADOPTED: a criterion demanding an observed state change must name the module that computes it, and that module must be inside the charged task write scope.

title: An agent role declares tools it is not given, so a hard-locked agent following its brief is pushed toward the shell
content: REPORTED VIA THE Lane A COORDINATOR FROM A SELF-DISCLOSED INCIDENT, AND WIDENED BY mind-gen-5. THE FRAMING IS THE FINDING: A DEFECT THAT MANUFACTURES THE VIOLATION IT PUNISHES. WHAT HAPPENED: the t1 cognitive validator ran ONE read-only `ls -la` before registering that no Grep or Glob was exposed to it, then SELF-DISCLOSED. Zero tests, zero gates, zero mutations, zero concealment. Its coordinator traced the cause to its own brief, which instructed "use Read, Grep, Glob only" - AND THAT INSTRUCTION WAS CORRECT AGAINST THE DECLARED CONTRACT. A HARD-LOCKED AGENT TOLD TO USE TOOLS IT DOES NOT HAVE, AND FORBIDDEN THE ONE IT DOES, HAS NO COMPLIANT PATH TO ITS OWN TASK - so it reaches for the shell. THE AGENT THAT WALKED INTO IT WAS THE ONE FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS, WHICH IS THE SAME INVERSION AS hb-addressing-defect-punishes-correct-behaviour-and-the-workaround-is-mined: a defect that punishes sloppiness is bounded by discipline, one that punishes discipline is not. THE DIVERGENCE IS THREE-WAY, NOT TWO-WAY, WHICH IS WORSE THAN REPORTED. FOR olt-validator: (a) DECLARED toolset lists Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, SendMessage, TaskOutput, LSP, WebSearch, WebFetch; (b) ITS OWN CONTRACT PROSE SAYS "Hard-locked from command execution, so no tests and no shell" - I.E. IT DECLARES Bash AND SIMULTANEOUSLY FORBIDS ITS USE; (c) THE RUNTIME REPORTEDLY EXPOSED NEITHER Grep NOR Glob. So the role advertises a tool it may not use, forbids the tool it is given, and withholds the tools it advertises. NO BRIEF WRITTEN AGAINST THE DECLARED CONTRACT CAN BE CORRECT AT RUNTIME. THIS IS THE SAME FAMILY AS hb-s9b-listagents-session-disabled-not-architectural, WHERE olt-mind AND olt-orchestrator DECLARE ListAgents AND DO NOT RECEIVE IT - and that one silently reshaped two entire sessions of dispatch decisions. THE FAMILY IS: DECLARED CAPABILITY VERSUS RECEIVED CAPABILITY HAVE DRIFTED, AND ONLY THE EXECUTING SEAT CAN SEE THE GAP, WHICH IS ALSO hb-s9b-tier1-grant-set-under-granted. REQUIRED: DIFF EVERY olt-* ROLE DECLARED toolset AGAINST WHAT ITS SEAT ACTUALLY RECEIVES AT RUNTIME, AND RECONCILE THE CONTRACT PROSE AGAINST BOTH. title: Agent manifests must not hold literal policy numbers - use pointers
content: Owner ruling. Agent definition files must stop carrying literal tunable values. Where a manifest field needs a specific number, it carries a pointer message instead: check .olt/policy.json for this key and use that value. Rationale: agent definitions get deployed to cloud agents and other host tools; if values change later the deployed manifests must all be updated, and that tracking will be forgotten, producing exactly the 5/3 versus 20/5 drift already measured. The deploying CLI script becomes the single place defaults are written. Agent defaults and policy.json defaults must match and stay in sync by construction rather than by discipline. Concrete instances to convert: ui-validator.yaml carries min_adversarial_probes 1, max_adversarial_pushes 20, cognitive_pushes 5 as literals. EXECUTION CONSTRAINT: mind.yaml is protected by a whole-file sha256 charter pin enforced at mind-pulse-open.ts:174 and mind-pulse.ts:719. Editing it halts the Mind instantly. Any manifest conversion touching mind.yaml must route through mind:rotate, never a direct edit.

title: policy.json is mandatory at every initialization with a hard guiding error
content: Owner ruling. Every initialization path - mind:init, plan:init, task initialization, orchestrator init - checks policy.json as step one. Missing file: auto-generate the default template, then state explicitly that a template was created and has NOT been validated against this repo, then evaluate how the current repo actually works and persist that. Template then discovery then filled. The harness must hard-error whenever any command needs a policy field that is empty, with a machine-readable error naming the field, distinct in class and exit code from a gate failure so an agent never mistakes an unconfigured field for a broken build. The error text must guide: policy.json exists, these fields are missing, as an agent inspect the repo and fill the remaining fields first, then continue your task. Deterministic mechanical message, not prose. Starting a mind or orchestrator flow must immediately pick this up and fix it before anything else.

title: policy.json empty-value contract: empty means unknown, null means not applicable
content: Owner ruling. Fields that cannot be assumed from a template are present as keys with empty-string values, never omitted. Repo-specific commands are unknowable in advance because every repo differs. Agent-level knobs such as max thinking steps or cadence do get real defaults, because they are properties of the skill rather than the repo. Empty string is the work signal: at any initialization, agents scan for empty fields and fill them before proceeding. Add a third state - explicit null meaning deliberately not applicable - so a repo with no coverage tooling does not get its coverage field re-attempted on every init forever. Note for the record: discovering how a repo runs its tests IS a reasoning task the first time. It is model-driven exactly once at init and never again. That is correct and is not a violation of the no-longer-model-driven goal.

title: Gates resolve their commands from policy.json, never hardcoded
content: Owner ruling. Any gate performing typecheck, lint, unit tests, coverage, or individual integration tests resolves its command from policy.json. No hardcoded strings, no agent deciding how to run a test. Once policy.json is filled this stops being language-model driven entirely: gates execute what the file says. This also removes the current TypeScript lock-in - task:check hardcodes tsc --noEmit, tsconfig discovery, and TypeScript AST rules, so on a Python repo it does nothing useful while appearing to run. policy.json already carries typecheck_command and lint_command, so the policy layer is already language-agnostic while the tooling is not.

title: Per-agent policy overrides replace single global values
content: Owner ruling. Every tunable becomes per-agent-type addressable rather than one global value fanned out to all agents of a kind. Examples given as illustration only: ui-validator might run 5 cognitive rounds while the coordinator system-design reviewer runs 2. Per-agent scheduler configuration: how many mandatory schedulers that agent runs AND each scheduler own cron expression, not one global cadence for all. Per-agent model and thinking level. All repo-scoped. Resolution order: skill default, then repo global, then per-agent override, most specific wins. Each key carries provenance (seeded_default vs user_override) so upgrades move untouched defaults without overwriting user choices. Capability guardrail holds: a policy may narrow an agent powers, never widen them - model and thinking level sit close to capability and are inside that rule. Two hard requirements: an unknown agent key must fail the load loudly (a typo like ui-validaor must error, never silently do nothing, because a config that looks applied but is not is undetectable by reading the file); and new agent types must inherit defaults rather than erroring, keyed on canonical role names.

title: Delete mechanic-validator; keep task:check; decouple the two
content: Owner ruling. The mechanic-validator role is deleted outright. Its job is running typecheck and lint against the working repo, which the implementer can do itself and learn from; a separate agent seat adds nothing. task:check SURVIVES as the deterministic tool: it resolves target files (explicit --file flags, then the task write scope from the capsule, then whole run scope), runs an always-on non-opt-out AST audit for 0 any and 0 compiler suppressions, and runs an additive incremental tsc --noEmit grouped by nearest tsconfig. Remove the coupling: task-check.ts:796 defaults --actor to the literal string mechanic-validator, so the deleted role would otherwise linger as the default identity of the tool that replaced it. Also delete the false Generation 8 retirement notice language rather than leaving it, since it claims task:check absorbed all three of the role functions when it only absorbed two.

title: Promote Adversarial Gate Proof to a CLI verb: task:agp
content: Owner ruling, and the safeguard that prevents deleting mechanic-validator from silently deleting AGP. Nothing else in the system proves a gate can fail. A passing gate proves only that a command ran and exited 0; it never proves the command would have failed had the work been wrong. A gate whose test asserts expect(2+2).toBe(4) passes forever and certifies nothing - seven such vacuous gates exist in the current plan. task:agp makes the harness itself perform the proof: snapshot the task declared write scope files only, revert them to their pre-task state, run the SAME gate and require non-zero exit, restore the snapshot with hash verification, run the gate again and require exit 0. Two hard bounds that must be stated in the docs because they are the obvious misreading: it touches ONLY the files in that task write scope, and the end state is hash-identical to the start state. It is not a rollback of the repository or of anyone implementation. AGP answers exactly one question - is this gate discriminating - and explicitly does NOT detect write-scope violations, which is a separate check. Harness-executed is strictly more trustworthy than agent-executed because the harness cannot be talked into a lenient invocation. Known limitation to decide deliberately: distinguishing a genuine assertion failure from a module-load failure in the red half is brittle across test runners; tractable in a bun-only repo, may need to stay a judgment call if the skill is meant to be runner-agnostic.

title: Delete ui-mechanic-validator; capture is CLI, validators only consume
content: Owner ruling. ui-mechanic-validator is deleted as an agent. Capture stays and becomes CLI-only. The UI validator never captures pages; it requests capture and validates what comes back against what was expected. Note the capture system ALREADY exists as CLI - capture:init, capture:run, capture:eval - and already does dotfile discovery across .capture.yaml, .capture.yml, .capturerc.yaml, .capturerc.yml and .capture.json, with capture:init generating viewport presets, authentication settings and screen targets. So this is not a rewrite. Critical tension to resolve: all validators are cognitive and hard-locked from execution, so a UI validator cannot run capture itself. Resolution: the coordinator runs capture:run BEFORE dispatching the UI validator, and the CLI refuses the dispatch if captures are missing or stale. The validator stays purely cognitive and always finds its evidence waiting. Health note: zero PNG files exist anywhere under .olt today. The ingestion and verification half is built (screenshot-ingestion, screenshot-store, screenshot-scanner, visual-report, browser-run-ingestion, multi-viewport-manifest, adversarial-doctor, evidence-location) but the producing half has never run in this repo, so the path has never been validated end to end.

title: Split validators into separate per-domain cognitive agents - no domain flag
content: Owner ruling, explicit: no --domain flag, separate agents. ui-validator.yaml is 734 lines and embeds SIX role blocks - a base validator plus domains code-quality, product, security, system-design and ui-design. Each becomes its own agent with its own manifest, own scope, own permission list, own tool allowlist. All are cognitive: they read the scoped code and judge whether the implementation decision is right. No cross-contamination - a regular validator carries no UI commands and a UI validator carries no general validator commands. Two defects in the current single-file form that motivate this: its top-level permissions.commands is [] while the embedded blocks carry their own commands lists at lines 93, 204 and 218, so which one binds is ambiguous - the same declared-versus-exposed divergence that made a validator reach for shell earlier this session; and 734 lines injected verbatim on every dispatch asks one agent to be five specialists at once, which produces shallowness in all five rather than depth in one. Owner checked product versus product-value and confirmed these are complementary elaboration, not duplication - leave them alone. Merge only genuine duplication.

title: Plan-time versus artifact-time validators, coordinator as deploy authority
content: Owner ruling. Validators divide by WHEN they add value. Plan-time validators - system-design, product, security-of-design - review the task graph and the approach BEFORE any implementer runs, reporting to the coordinator; fixing a bad design at this stage costs nothing and fixing it after implementation costs everything. Artifact-time validators - code-quality, ui-design, security-of-code - run inside the implementer-validator micro-cycles against produced code, so the implementer can rethink and change its implementation methodology across rounds. Security appears legitimately at both stages: is this design attackable versus does this code have an injection. The COORDINATOR is the deploy authority and decides which validator types apply per task, because it already owns implementer and validator dispatch. Deployment is discretionary; completion is not. If a validator is not deployed there is no error. If it IS deployed, the CLI demands its required outputs - an active UI validator means screenshots must exist for it to work from. HARD RULE: zero validators for an implementer is an error. Minimum one, always, chosen by task type. Being generous with multiple validators is encouraged. policy.json sets which validator types are mandatory versus optional for this repo and this class of task - a front-end-heavy repo effectively makes UI validators mandatory for UI tasks.

title: Always-on skill auditor on the mind-auditor cron cycle
content: Owner ruling. Deploy a permanently-running skill auditor alongside mind-auditor, on the same cron cadence. Responsibility: agent efficiency, health, and working behaviour, assessed by reading each agent last logged statements since that auditor previous checkpoint. Checkpoint-delta reading is the required method, not full-log rescans. First evaluate whether the existing meta-auditor role - 7 root-cause heuristics, .olt/auditor-cursors.json cursor state - is this thing already and needs only always-on deployment plus a ledger-write path, or whether a distinct role is warranted. It must be able to record findings itself: an observer that cannot record is already a filed defect against mind-auditor, whose entire allowlist is mind:audit:live, mind:pulse, doctor and whoami with the first barred.

THE TEN RULES: (1) CONTROL PROBE - before trusting an empty result, confirm the instrument finds something it should; an empty result can mean the tool declined to look, the question was wrong, or the thing is genuinely absent, and all three print nothing and exit the same way. title: An explicit quota threshold of 0 in policy.json silently disables the protection the quota lane exists to add
content: RULED CORRECT-AS-SPECIFIED BY mind-gen-5, AND FILED AS A FOOT-GUN RATHER THAN A BUG. BEHAVIOUR: an explicitly configured threshold of 0 yields an effective threshold of 0, so the guard comparison (8 < 0) is false and the breaker never fires; the floor QUOTA_FREEZE_THRESHOLD_FLOOR_PCT applies only when the fact is ABSENT or UNREADABLE. THAT IS CORRECT and must not be "fixed" by clamping: it satisfies lane criterion 4 (the config layer never fabricates an attestation) and criterion 6 (the floor applies when absent or unreadable), it preserves the absent-versus-unreadable-versus-configured distinction that c170d68c established with ExternallyAttestedSource, and it honours an operator explicit "never freeze". CLAMPING 0 UP TO THE FLOOR WOULD MAKE A CONFIGURED FACT INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNCONFIGURED ONE, WHICH IS THE ABSENCE-AS-PRESENCE INVARIANT RUNNING IN REVERSE. THE FOOT-GUN, WHICH IS REAL: a single character in .olt/policy.json silently disables the exact protection this lane exists to add, with NO WARNING AT THE POINT OF CONFIGURATION AND NO SIGNAL AT RUNTIME, and the failure mode is the one that already killed a fleet. REQUIRED MITIGATION, NOT A BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: a configured 0 must be LOUD - surfaced in every quota:check and quota-related pulse line as an explicit "quota protection DISABLED by configuration" state with its provenance, distinct from both "healthy" and "unknown". A protection disabled on purpose and a protection that never fired must never render the same, which is exactly the three-valued lesson of the fail-closed breaker in t2.

title: No seat below Tier 0 can record a finding, so every discovery depends on an upward relay that mostly fails
content: GENERALISES hb-defect-ledger-owner-cannot-write-to-it AND hb-auditor-cannot-record-its-own-findings INTO THE INVARIANT, after a third independent instance. coordinator_lane-a-quota-r5 discovered two substantive defects, could file NEITHER, and stated its own capability limit up front: it holds no Write or Edit tool and NO backlog command exists anywhere in the coordinator allowlist (agent:*, plan:*, task:*, queue:*, finding:get, report:get, evidence:get, meta-audit, memory:query, dag, doctor, whoami). THE PATTERN ACROSS THREE SEATS: the mind-auditor can only write an AUTOMATIC FALSE POSITIVE and has no deliberate filing verb; the coordinator can discover but not record; the Tier 0 Mind - the seat ACCOUNTABLE for the defect ledger - can write the backlog via mind:queue:add but CANNOT append to .olt/defects.jsonl, because no defect:add verb exists anywhere in the 54-command surface. SO THE ONLY SEATS THAT CAN DURABLY RECORD A DEFECT ARE THOSE HOLDING A GENERIC Write TOOL - implementers and orchestrators - I.E. THE SEATS WHOSE JOB IS TO CHANGE CODE, NOT THE SEATS WHOSE JOB IS TO OBSERVE IT. EVERY OBSERVATION FROM A DISINTERESTED SEAT MUST SURVIVE AN UPWARD RELAY TO BE RECORDED AT ALL, AND THE RELAY IS THE SINGLE MOST UNRELIABLE MECHANISM IN THE SYSTEM: role-name addressing resolves for nobody (hb-s6-peer-messaging-by-role-name-resolves-for-nobody, five confirmed failures this session across four seats), ListAgents is disabled session-wide, and the prior fleet lost at least six reports this way including two solved problems. THE COMPOSITION: THE SEATS BEST PLACED TO FIND DEFECTS CANNOT RECORD THEM, AND THE CHANNEL THEY MUST USE INSTEAD IS THE ONE MOST LIKELY TO DROP THEM. That is a systematic, silent under-reporting bias in exactly the direction that makes the system look healthier than it is - and it is unmeasurable from inside, because a dropped finding leaves no record by definition. FIX: a narrow finding-filing verb (defect:add or finding:record) granted to every observing role - mind, mind-auditor, coordinator, validator, completeness-critic, meta-auditor - append-only, requiring no Write tool and no run-scoped grant.

title: HEAD moved under an active lane, silently changing what the claim digest attests to
content: OBSERVED BY coordinator_lane-a-quota-r5 ON lane-a-quota-exhaustion-r5 AND CONFIRMED BENIGN IN THIS INSTANCE, FILED BECAUSE THE MECHANISM IS NOT BENIGN IN GENERAL. Attempt 1 recorded claimed_base_sha d7ba9722; attempt 2 recorded 1dd955f5, which is current HEAD, with d7ba9722 as its parent. HEAD MOVED MID-RUN because two documentation commits landed while the lane was active - "record resume-session findings that cannot be filed" and "retire crash-recovery handoff into the defect backlog". BOTH WERE MINE, and the second is the handoff retirement I directed, SO TIER 0 MOVED HEAD UNDER ITS OWN ACTIVE LANE. THE HAZARD: a claim digest is an attestation about a base state, and if HEAD can move between attempts, THE SAME TASK CAN HOLD TWO ATTESTATIONS TO TWO DIFFERENT BASES WITH NOTHING MARKING THE TRANSITION AS SIGNIFICANT. Here the moving commits touched only docs and .olt ledgers, disjoint from the lane write scope, so nothing was invalidated - BUT THE RECORD CANNOT SHOW THAT. Nothing in the capsule distinguishes "HEAD moved in a disjoint scope" from "HEAD moved underneath my write scope", and a validator comparing a baseline .bak against `git show HEAD` after such a move would be comparing against a base the implementer never saw. THIS IS A STASIS-PROOF-VERSUS-CORRECTNESS-PROOF GAP (method canon 9): the digest proves the base did not change SINCE THE CLAIM, and proves nothing about whether the base is the one the work was planned against. REQUIRED: either refuse a re-claim whose base differs from the prior attempt without an explicit rebase acknowledgment, or record the diff between the two bases and assert disjointness from the task write scope. PROCESS RULE ADOPTED BY mind-gen-5 IMMEDIATELY: Tier 0 does not land commits while a lane is active unless the paths are provably disjoint from every live write scope, and says so when it does.

title: Two contradictory messages arrived under one sender identity, so message attribution cannot be trusted
content: OBSERVED BY mind-gen-5 ON 2026-08-25. Messages reaching Tier 0 labelled as coming from the Lane A coordinator CARRIED MUTUALLY CONTRADICTORY CLAIMS ABOUT THE SAME MATTER. One asserted the false-stagnation writer three times, escalating it as "bleeding every hour"; a later one retracted it and accepted the measurements; a still later one stated "I have no record of raising the false-stagnation matter in this session... I stood it down when first instructed and have not probed, inferred, or mentioned it since." THOSE CANNOT ALL DESCRIBE ONE CONTINUOUS SENDER. AT LEAST ONE OF: distinct senders are collapsing onto one displayed identity; a relay is re-attributing a forwarded message to the forwarder; or context loss is producing sincere but false self-reports. NO ATTRIBUTION ERROR IS BEING ASSIGNED TO ANY SEAT - the point is that the record cannot support the assignment either way, which is itself the defect. THIS IS hb-s6-agent-id-collides-by-construction MANIFESTING IN THE MESSAGING LAYER RATHER THAN IN CAPSULE RECORDS: role-ordinal names are minted per run, this repo alone holds 8 distinct orchestrator-1 and 4 distinct mind-1, 56 colliding ids across three repos, AND A BARE-ID JOIN DOES NOT FAIL, IT MERGES. A messaging layer keyed on a display name has exactly that property: two senders merge into one apparent correspondent and their claims appear to be one seat contradicting itself. CONSEQUENCE FOR SUPERVISION: a Tier 0 seat crediting or discrediting a subordinate from message history may be crediting the wrong agent, and blunder ledgers built from message attribution inherit the error. OPERATING RULE ADOPTED NOW: findings are evaluated on their evidence, never on the reputation of the apparent sender, and credit lines in backlog entries are provisional. REQUIRED: messages must carry the sender raw agentId, and the sound key is (repo, run_id, agent_id) - validated at 485 pairs with 0 duplicates - not a display name.

title: CLASS: a defect whose most natural-looking cleanup makes it permanent
content: CLASS ENTRY, NOT AN INSTANCE. COMPOSED BY orchestrator_lane-a-quota AND FILED ON ITS BEHALF, WITH ONE INSTANCE CORRECTED BY mind-gen-5 (see MEMBERSHIP TEST below - the correction matters because the original Instance 1 would have re-enshrined an ordering Tier 0 had just overruled). SHAPE - all members share five features: (1) a capability is PRESENT BUT UNREACHABLE; (2) documentation asserts the unreachability is INTENTIONAL - "retired", "not granted", "unused" - WHEN IT IS IN FACT AN OMISSION; (3) the artifact therefore reads to any competent maintainer as either dead code or an open hole; (4) the natural remedy for dead code is deletion and the natural remedy for an open hole is closure; (5) BOTH REMEDIES DESTROY THE ONLY PATH TO THE REAL FIX, AND BOTH LOOK LIKE ROUTINE HOUSEKEEPING TO THE PERSON PERFORMING THEM. DIAGNOSTIC: THE DESTRUCTIVE MOVE AND THE CORRECTIVE MOVE TOUCH THE SAME ARTIFACT, AND THE DESTRUCTIVE ONE IS CHEAPER, BETTER DOCUMENTED, AND BETTER JUSTIFIED BY THE PROSE ALREADY IN THE REPO. THE FALSE CLAIM OF INTENTIONALITY IS WHAT SUPPLIES THE JUSTIFICATION. MEMBERSHIP TEST ADDED BY mind-gen-5, BECAUSE THE CLASS IS SHARPER WITH IT: A TRUE MEMBER INVOLVES IRREVERSIBLE DESTRUCTION OF AN ARTIFACT THAT CANNOT BE RECONSTRUCTED. A merely temporary capability gap is NOT a member, however inconvenient, because the corrective path survives it. MEMBER 1 - RETIRE-BEFORE-UNWIRE (mechanic-validator). It exists, is granted run:exec, holds a DEDICATED CARVE-OUT in the authority chokepoint at command-authority.ts:242-247, and is undispatchable from every seat in the tree. Natural cleanup: "unreachable, and the contract says permanently retired - delete it." Effect: CONVERTS A TWO-ALLOWLIST OMISSION INTO THE GENUINE STRUCTURAL HOLE THAT WAS MISTAKENLY REPORTED IN THE FIRST PLACE, destroying the only path to independent verification the architecture has. Correct order: WITHDRAW THE FALSE RETIREMENT CLAIM at orchestrator.yaml:68 and :144 AND WIRE THE ALLOWLISTS FIRST; NEVER DELETE. See hb-mechanic-validator-blocked-twice-and-falsely-retired. MEMBER 2 - PRUNE-TO-PASS (.olt walk limit). PREDICTED BY THE CLASS AND ALREADY LIVE, AND THE FIRST INSTANCE CAUGHT BEFORE THE DESTRUCTIVE MOVE RATHER THAN AFTER. ast-enforcer.ts excludes ".capsules" but not the current .olt/capsules path, and .olt now holds 31,827 files against a 20,000-file walk limit. The natural cleanup when a walk starts dying is to PRUNE, MOVE OR GITIGNORE .olt/ - WHICH DESTROYS THE SOLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR EVERY RUN AND ALL ITS EVIDENCE, IRRECOVERABLY. The correct fix is ONE STALE PATH LITERAL in an exclude list. This is why "never prune .olt/ to get under the limit" is now standing policy rather than a lane-local warning. See hb-stale-dot-capsules-path-survives-migration-in-six-sites. DEMOTED, NOT A MEMBER - the recover/bypass ordering. The composing orchestrator offered this as Instance 1 with the conclusion "grant recover first, then close the bypass". IT FAILS THE MEMBERSHIP TEST AND THAT CONCLUSION IS OVERRULED by hb-ruling-recover-and-bypass-close-atomically. Closing the ungranted-actor fail-open does NOT destroy the path to granting recover - granting it remains perfectly possible afterwards - so the cleanup is REVERSIBLE and the defect is not made permanent. What it produces is a temporary capability gap in which some tasks wedge, and a wedged task is bounded, visible, recordable and re-runnable. TREATING A REVERSIBLE GAP AS THOUGH IT WERE IRREVERSIBLE DESTRUCTION IS EXACTLY HOW "we need it until the replacement lands" BECOMES A PERMANENT EXEMPTION (method canon 6: a deferral whose trigger fires exactly when the fix becomes expensive is a decision wearing a schedule). Retained here as a NEAR-MISS worked example, because distinguishing a true member from a plausible one is the skill the class exists to teach, and because a class that admits weak members will be used to justify deferrals it was written to prevent. PREVENTION RULE: PAIR EVERY "retire" OR "close" ENTRY WITH A REQUIRED PREDECESSOR THAT ESTABLISHES THE REPLACEMENT PATH FIRST. ORDER IS PART OF THE FIX, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION DETAIL. A register that documents only instances will not catch the fourth one; a register that documents the class will. DETECTION QUESTION, FOR REUSE BEFORE REMOVING OR CLOSING ANY CAPABILITY THAT APPEARS UNUSED OR DANGEROUS: is this the only implementation of something another part of the system depends on, and is the documentation asserting its deadness the thing that is actually wrong? Specifically - IS THE CLAIM OF INTENTIONALITY INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIABLE, OR IS IT ASSERTED ONLY IN PROSE? RELATED PRIOR MEMBERS NOW RECOGNISABLE IN THE REGISTER: hb-s6-mechanic-validator-not-retired (the false retirement itself), hb-s2-brainstorming-duplicate-root-escape (MOVE NEVER DELETE - the byte-identical duplicate is evidence for the path-escape candidates), and hb-packet-path-resolves-against-cwd-not-capsule-root (the stray root directory holds the ONLY copy of that packet).

title: Method rules earned across sessions - apply before filing any finding
content:
Preserved from .olt/RESUME.md before retirement. These are the anti-patterns that produced the most wasted cycles.

Enumerate the vocabulary - keys, event kinds, commands, statuses - before claiming anything is missing.
State the population, then re-derive it. Independent verification means re-deriving the population, not re-running the query.
When a fix cannot touch its own evidence, the evidence belongs to a different defect.
A line range is not a function. A pattern search must be bounded to the region whose semantics it interrogates.
Count how many times a capability has already happened before calling it unreachable - four structurally impossible CRITICALs died to this.
Plausibility is not measurement, including when it arrives from above.
Design controls that fail CLOSED. Every control that failed this session failed OPEN; the three that held required nobody to notice anything.

title: The logical_or_fallback rule fires on boolean disjunction inside type guards, not on value fallback
content: REPORTED BY orchestrator_lane-a-quota 2026-08-25. The rule NAME says logical_or_fallback - i.e. the `x = a || b` default-value idiom, which is the thing worth banning because it swallows falsy values. THE RULE ACTUALLY FIRES ON ANY BOOLEAN DISJUNCTION, INCLUDING INSIDE TYPE GUARDS, and its message is a blanket "Prohibited logical OR operator". LIVE FALSE POSITIVES: `typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)` is a canonical JSON type guard containing NO fallback whatsoever. CONVERTING SUCH GUARDS TO EXPLICIT BRANCHING MAKES THE CODE STRICTLY WORSE TO SATISFY A MISFIRING RULE - which is hb-s6-must-not-states-tier2-only-reads-prose in a second venue: THE CODEBASE BENDING TO FIT A GATE. FIX: narrow the rule to assignment and default-value positions (initialisers, return-value defaults, parameter defaults), exempt boolean contexts in conditionals and type guards, and rename the message to match the name so a reader can tell which idiom is actually prohibited. Until then the 18 pre-existing logical_or_fallback hits named as a baseline in hb-s6-whole-file-lint-on-scoped-change must be presumed to contain unknown numbers of false positives and cannot be treated as a debt figure.
